retorno.titulo: What you already know and what is worth reviewing
retorno.lead: No grade and no comparison: it is a snapshot to guide your study.

ja-sabe.texto: You did well on these topics.

quase.texto: Not much left: a quick review helps.

rever.texto: These topics call for another pass through the lesson.

pouco-dado.texto: There are still too few answers on these topics to say anything.

retorno.vazio: There are no answers to show yet.
retorno.soNoAparelho: Saved only on this device. None of this goes to the internet.

prova.outrosModos: Other ways to take this exam
prova.emDupla: In pairs, on the same phone
prova.proficiencia: Proficiency exam (for those who already know)
prova.fimDupla: Exam taken in pairs. No score: look together at what you already know and what is worth reviewing.

dupla.texto: Two people, one phone. You take turns: for each question, one holds the phone and reads it aloud, you both talk it over, and only then tap the answer.
dupla.semPlacar: No score, no comparison between you and no grade at the end: only feedback on what you already know and what is worth reviewing.
dupla.combinem: Agree on the answer before tapping.

proficiencia.texto: This exam is for those who already know the subject of the track, learned in life, at work or elsewhere. It has all {n} questions of the track, and the right answer is not shown after each question: only at the end do you see the feedback by topic.
proficiencia.refazer: You can retake it as many times as you like. Getting things wrong here counts nothing against you.
proficiencia.naoEsconde: If you show you already know every topic, you can mark the track as exempted in your courses. No lesson disappears: they all stay open.

dispensa.pode: You showed you already know every topic in this track.
dispensa.naoAinda: The track cannot be exempted yet: review the topics above and retake it whenever you like.
dispensa.marcar: Mark this track as exempted in the course {curso}
dispensa.marcada: Exempted in the course {curso}. The lessons stay open.
dispensa.semCurso: To mark the exemption, join a School course that includes this track.

semana.lead: A week to see what you already know, calmly and in good company.
semana.proposto: Proposed calendar, to be confirmed by the coordination.
semana.antes: The next exam week runs from {inicio} to {fim}.
semana.durante: It is exam week: from {inicio} to {fim}.
semana.fora: Outside the week, each track's exam stays open on the track page, for practice.
semana.lembreteDescricao: The exams of the tracks in your courses, alone or in pairs. No grade: only feedback on what you already know and what is worth reviewing.
semana.solidariaTitulo: An exam week built on solidarity
solidaria: You can take it in pairs, on the same phone, talking before each answer.
You can study together beforehand: in a study group or with your class.
No score, no comparison and no grade at the end: only feedback on what you already know and what is worth reviewing.
semana.semInscricao: You have not joined any School course yet. The exams show up here when you join a course.
semana.semProva: No track in this course has an exam yet (an exam needs 10 or more questions).
semana.estudarJuntoTexto: Arrange with someone to study the lessons before the exam, in a study group or in your class.
semana.modulos: How I am doing in each module

modulo.lead: This feedback brings together the end-of-lesson quizzes and the exercises of these lessons done on this device. No grade: only what you already know and what is worth reviewing.
modulo.ultimo: This is the last module of the course.

lembra.titulo: Before you start: do you remember?
lembra.texto: Two questions from the lesson {aula}, which you already did. Recalling before learning something new helps it stick.

explique.titulo: Explain it in your own words
explique.texto: Tell, as if to someone at home, what you understood from this lesson. Writing or speaking in your own words helps you learn.
explique.aviso: None of this goes to the internet. The text stays on this device and goes into your backup copy. The recording stays only on this device and is not in the backup, because it is large. "Delete my data" deletes both.
explique.semMicrofone: This browser cannot record audio, or the microphone was not allowed. You can write instead.
explique.semTranscricao: The recording is not turned into text: it stays as you said it.

saberes.lead: A lot is learned through life: at work, in the struggle, at home. Here you show what you already know from a course and record it in your logbook.
saberes.naoEhCertificacao: A record of the Lúcia Maria School; it is not an official certification or a diploma.
saberes.encceja: For official certification of schooling in Brazil (elementary and secondary), the path is ENCCEJA.
saberes.escolha: Which course do you already master from life?
saberes.passo1Texto: Take the proficiency exam of each track in the course. It does not show the answer after each question, and you can retake it.
saberes.semProva: This track has no exam yet (an exam needs 10 or more questions). This knowledge can go in the note of the record.
saberes.passo2Texto: This is an alternance course: it has work-time tasks. Do each one live with an educator or with someone from the Núcleo, who checks it with you.
saberes.semPratica: This course has no practical assessment: the proficiency exams are enough.
saberes.avaliador: Name of the person who assessed you
saberes.permissao: This person allowed their name to be kept in my logbook.
saberes.faltaAvaliador: To record a checked practice task, write the name of the person who assessed you and tick that they allowed it.
saberes.nada: There is nothing to record yet: take a proficiency exam or check a practice task.
saberes.entrar: To mark tracks as exempted, join the course.
saberes.soNoAparelho: The record stays only on this device, in your logbook.
